title: Empat Minit Lambat
subject: a municipal clock winder in Taiping climbs the tower every Sunday and keeps the clock four minutes slow, the time his wife takes to wave from the window
caption: Ethio-jazz in the Addis Ababa 1970s style, hypnotic minor pentatonic groove with a lilting swung pulse. Vibraphone ostinato, tenor saxophone and muted trumpet playing winding unison lines, Fender Rhodes chords, round walking electric bass, brushed drum kit. Warm analog studio room, dry brass, soft vibraphone ring. Male baritone, smoky mid register, restrained delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 86 BPM, E minor. Wistful, dignified, slow-burning mood. No synth pad, no autotune, no rap, no EDM drums, no fast tempo.
lyrics:
[Intro - vibraphone ostinato, bass enters, saxophone line]

[Verse 1]
Setiap Ahad Pak Karim panjat menara
Seratus tiga puluh anak tangga
Dia buka pintu besi jam besar
Dia putar kunci, dia dengar roda

[Pre-Chorus]
Orang kata jam ini lambat
Dia senyum, dia diam saja

[Chorus]
Empat minit lambat, biarlah lambat
Tingkap rumah sana belum tertutup
Dia melambai, aku tengok sampai habis
Empat minit lambat, itu masa kami

[Verse 2]
Budak sekolah marah, lewat ke kelas
Kerani bank marah, lewat ke kaunter
Dia tak jawab, dia sapu minyak
Dia pandang jalan, pandang rumah kecil

[Bridge - trumpet and vibraphone alone]
Minggu depan dia lambai lagi
Jam berdetik, dia pun mengira

[Chorus]
Empat minit lambat, biarlah lambat
Tingkap rumah sana belum tertutup
Dia melambai, aku tengok sampai habis
Empat minit lambat, jangan betulkan

[Outro - vibraphone and saxophone, bass holds the pulse]
Jangan betulkan
